text_block_list.text:
"No... Earlier in the hallway, I attempted to join in on
the students' conversation to deepen our bond, butâ"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Before I realized it, I was speaking only of stiff, formal matters, as though delivering a speech from a podium.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In the end, she even had the cowering students saying, "We'll mend our ways."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I can only deeply reflect on my actions.

Symboli Rudolf let out a sigh,
looking a bit downcast...
